answer: Put Certified air traffic controller licence with aviation authority endorsement at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 429 aliases would need 429 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The jade test is the live device, the lagoon test is the locked stake, and the orchard test is the graded history no template can fake. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
